selection.rule: Primary criterion: validation MAE on grouped_v1 (T1). Candidates in order of complexity: E04_tfidf_word, E12_encoder, E10_lstm. A more complex candidate replaces the current choice only if it has lower validation MAE AND the 95% paired cluster-bootstrap CI of the MAE difference excludes 0.

H3.note: Primary test is B3 (E40 vs E42); the LSTM comparison is exploratory.

comparisons.verdict: no detectable difference under the §6 rule (CI excludes 0 but |effect| < seed SD)

exploratory.note: Not pre-registered; reported for completeness, no confirmatory claim.
